selectionRule: Separate raw rig/animation completeness from suitability as the first shared Original Fish baseline.

candidates.label: Guppy female
candidates.materials: four materials; BLEND/MASK/OPAQUE; specular-glossiness; author-labelled Heart layer
candidates.reason: Richest raw rig and two actions, but materially and anatomically specialised; poor first shared core because thin transparent fins, internal layer and freshwater-specific proportions would bias the baseline.

candidates.label: Rainbow Trout - Redband
candidates.materials: adult and Young meshes/materials; six authored clips
candidates.reason: Best action variety, but adult/Young is authored presentation rather than measured growth and source review is not yet a clean biological lifecycle foundation.

candidates.label: Tuna Fish
candidates.sourceIdentity: marine fusiform bony fish; exact tuna species not independently verified
candidates.materials: separate body, eye and cornea; metallic-roughness; cornea BLEND
candidates.variantIntegrity: nodes, meshes, skins, animations, materials and all 603 decoded accessor arrays exactly equal; image payloads differ
candidates.reason: Not the largest rig, but the best balance of typical marine spindle form, dense single-cycle motion coverage, clean body/eye/cornea separation, moderate geometry cost, permissive CC-BY source declaration and duplicated export integrity.

candidates.label: Great Hammerhead Shark
candidates.reason: Useful named gill/jaw and shark-body reference, but distinct cartilaginous-fish anatomy and CC-BY-NC source make it unsuitable as the first shared bony-fish core.

candidates.label: Koi Fish
candidates.reason: Valuable proof that motion can be morph-based without bones; not the first skeleton standardization source.

candidates.label: Giant Trevally
candidates.reason: CC0 and game-relevant but has no source motion or rig; cannot bootstrap the motion/skeleton line.

selected.purpose: First complete semantic-rig and motion normalization pass for Original Fish
notClaims: This does not prove the source animation is biologically correct.
This does not identify the exact tuna species from the filename alone.
This does not authorize copying the source mesh, texture or keyframes into the native runtime.
This does not make all fish share tuna proportions.

currentBlocker.note: Repository contains detailed audit records, not the raw tuna binaries. Do not substitute a similarly named tuna.
